system.description:
Built on Project FU's Gourmet.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Inventory Points

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise.)

COOK SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000073]{Cooking} 【Max SL 5】

The engine. Gain (SL) ingredients when resting in a settlement; carry up to 10 + (SL × 5), and they never spoil. Action: combine 2–3 ingredients into a delicacy, then apply it to yourself or an ally you can see — or make a damageless free attack that applies it to each enemy hit.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000074]{Knife and Fork}

Cooking's free attack may deal real damage (High Roll treated as 0) if the delicacy used at most 2 ingredients.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000075]{Made with Love} 【Max SL 3】

When applying a delicacy to yourself or an ally, spend up to (SL × 10) MP: every 10 MP feeds one additional ally you can see.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000076]{Salt and Pepper}

When preparing a delicacy, spend 2 IP to change one ingredient's taste to any taste you choose.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000077]{Traveling Cook} 【Max SL 3】

After each travel roll, gain (SL × 2) ingredients (requires Cooking).
